CAPSTONE ABSTAINED (batch-03 100% guide-silent) — t4_door routed from core identity (reserved-aura constant-DoT = uptime engine) + probe economy fact (reserve model) per template fallback clause. WITHER NOTE: probe-facts lists 'wither' (a chaos-DoT-amp debuff stacking on enemies); no clean 16-ailment lane for wither-as-damage-amp (it is a taken-more-chaos-DoT stacking hex-adjacent effect) — nearest is curse:amplify but wither is self-applied-on-hit not a cast hex; recorded here, not minted (single instance).
